title: Define text-to-image rendering and template boundary before T2I parity
description: AstrBot has a large T2I rendering surface with remote/local strategies, templates, file service choices, and markdown-like layout behavior. Keep this out of RespondStage and WebChat routes by defining a rendering crate boundary before T2I parity.

files.change: Define renderer input/output contracts independent of pipeline and HTTP transport.
Represent active template, strategy selection, and output artifact metadata.

criteria: RespondStage remains transport-agnostic and does not render images directly.
WebChat routes only expose rendered artifact descriptors through existing attachment/storage boundaries.
T2I strategy selection is typed and testable.
